mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with promethazine (anticholinergic/antihistamine) increases risk of severe anticholinergic toxicity, hypertensive crisis, and excessive CNS depression through additive pharmacodynamic effects and potential sympathomimetic potentiation.
action: Avoid this combination; if essential, use with extreme caution under close monitoring including blood pressure, heart rate, and mental status checks, with dose adjustments and extended washout periods considered.
